description: Change an existing campaign's bidding strategy (MAXIMIZE_CLICKS, MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS, TARGET_CPA, TARGET_ROAS, MANUAL_CPC). CRITICAL: switching a standard strategy with an empty payload is a silent no-op in the client — this tool forces a non-empty sub-field and READS BACK bidding_strategy_type to confirm the swap actually landed. Use MAXIMIZE_CLICKS with a cpcBidCeilingUsd to break a new-campaign cold-start (no conversion history). Refs #5764.

cpcBidCeilingUsd.description: For MAXIMIZE_CLICKS: max CPC ceiling in USD (strongly recommended to avoid runaway CPC). Required for MAXIMIZE_CLICKS.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

enhancedCpc.description: For MANUAL_CPC: enable Enhanced CPC. Default false.

targetCpaUsd.description: For TARGET_CPA: target cost per acquisition in USD.

targetRoas.description: For TARGET_ROAS: target return on ad spend as a fraction (e.g. 3.0 = 300%).

name: gads_set_bidding_strategy
